extracted.name: Miso Maple-Glazed Salmon
extracted.description: Chef John's miso maple-glazed salmon recipe uses salty, savory yellow miso paste, sweet maple syrup, seasoned rice wine vinegar, and Sriracha hot sauce.
ingredient_lines: 1 teaspoon hot chili sauce (such as Sriracha®)
2 (6 ounce) center-cut salmon fillets, with skin
instruction_lines: Set an oven rack about 6 inches from the heat source and preheat the oven's broiler. Brush an oven-safe skillet with vegetable oil.
Whisk miso paste, rice wine vinegar, maple syrup, and hot chili sauce together in a bowl.
Arrange salmon fillets, skin-sides down, in the prepared skillet. Place skillet over medium heat; cook until skin starts to sizzle, 2 to 3 minutes. Remove skillet from heat.
Brush salmon fillets with miso glaze. Place skillet in the preheated broiler; cook until salmon is just cooked through and top is browned, about 8 minutes.
Remove fillets from skillet, separating flesh from skins; leave skins in the pan.
